guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Standard / Fender Telecaster / Danelectro
guitar.evidence: Jimmy Page's 1959 Gibson Les Paul ('Number One') is one of the most iconic guitars in rock history, alongside his well-documented use of a Telecaster (Stairway to Heaven solo) and Danelectro for alternate tunings.

tone.target: raw open-tuning slide crunch with biting Plexi/Marshall upper mids
tone.profile: raw open-tuning slide crunch with biting Plexi/Marshall upper mids
tone.summary: A crunchy signal chain utilizing a Boost/OD pedal to drive the UK 45 amp model, paired with a Marshall-style cabinet and minimal room reverb for bite and aggression.

blocks.gap: The RAT-style is excellent, but a dedicated Plexi model would be ideal. Using it to achieve the aggressive mid-focus.
